{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders
completed_clean = completed[completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders (to avoid estimating)
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed)}')

# Print the number of QA orders in completed set
print(f'Number of QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Print the mean revenue
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}')"}
